Although CMS on Monday said it would
Medicare payment rates for laboratory services by 15% starting in 2026 — with further reductions through 2029 — Labcorp Holdings
said the changes will not impact its 2026-2029 long-term outlook.

The company reaffirmed that during that period, it expects compound annual revenue growth between 5% and 8%; adjusted operating margin expansion between 75 and 150 basis points by the end of 2029; compound annual adjusted EPS growth between 8.5% and 11.5%; and compound annual free cash flow growth in line with adjusted earnings growth.

Labcorp said it had "considered the anticipated continuation of [Protecting Access to Medicare Act]-related reimbursement pressure in developing" the guidance, which was released at its Investor Day on Sept. 10.
